title: Blown Away
description: An Irish explosive expert targets an old foe and his family living in Boston.

title: The Foreigner
description: A businessman embarks on a revenge-fueled vendetta after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing. His search leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

title: Missing in Action
description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) escapes from the Viet Cong, then comes back with a floating arsenal to get others out.

title: Missing in Action 2: The Beginning
description: An imprisoned U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) fights the military overlord (Oh Soon-tek) of a slave-labor opium operation in Vietnam.

title: Braddock: Missing in Action III
description: A U.S. colonel (Chuck Norris) returns to Vietnam and fights his way out with his wife, son (Roland Harrah III) and Amerasian orphans.

title: Ip Man
description: The life story of Yip Man, the first person to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun.

title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
description: Wing Chun martial arts master Ip Man moves to Hong Kong to create a school where he can teach his fighting techniques to a new generation. Instead, he's drawn into a showdown with a merciless boxer known as the Twister.

title: Ip Man 3
description: Martial-arts master Ip Man takes on a crooked developer and his gang of brutal thugs.

title: Ip Man 4: The Finale
description: Ip Man and his son encounter racial discrimination after traveling to the United States to seek a better life.

title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
description: Defeated by Master Ip, martial arts expert Cheung Tin Chi tries to lead a normal life in Hong Kong until triad leaders draw him back into fighting.

title: The Perfect Weapon
description: An expert in "kenpo" karate avenges his Chinatown friend, slain by a mobster in Los Angeles.

title: Rebel Without a Crew
description:
S01 E08 — Testing Their Limits
Alejandro pushes one of his actors for more, testing her creative limit, and her patience; Josh fights through audio issues and time constraints plaguing his film.

description: A hit man must beat the top assassins in the world to protect the ungrateful son of a mafia boss, save the life of his only friend, and rekindle his relationship with his maniacal father figure.

description:

Bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko head for the Mexican border, encountering a deadly standoff at a liquor store along the way; Richie is haunted by visions of demons and a mysterious woman.

description:

The Gecko brothers flee the liquor store with Ranger Freddie Gonzalez in pursuit; Richie's visions escalate; the Geckos nearly collide with the Fullers, a troubled family making its own desperate journey to Mexico.
